info.name: Teams Platform API - Phase 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
info.description:
Complete API collection for Teams collaboration platform.

**Phases:**
- Phase 1 – Auth & Users
- Phase 2 – Teams / Channels / Messages
- Phase 3 – Attachments / Notifications / Audit Logs
- Phase 4 – Organizations & Members
- Phase 5 – Unified Chat (REST + WebSocket/STOMP)

**WebSocket quick-start (Phase 5):**
1. Connect to `ws://localhost:8080/api/v1/ws` (SockJS fallback also available)
2. In the STOMP CONNECT frame add header `Authorization: Bearer <token>`
3. Subscribe to `/topic/conversations/{conversationId}`
4. Send messages to `/app/conversations/{conversationId}/send` with JSON body `{"content":"Hello!"}`

PHASE 5 - Unified Chat (REST)
item.description:
REST endpoints for the unified chat system.

Conversation types:
- DIRECT  – 1-to-1 between two users, created on demand via POST /conversations/direct
- TEAM    – automatically created when a team is created; retrieved via GET /teams/{id}/conversation
- CHANNEL – automatically created when a channel is created; retrieved via GET /channels/{id}/conversation

All endpoints require Authorization: Bearer <token>.
The 'Start Direct Conversation' and 'Get Team/Channel Conversation' requests automatically save the returned conversation_id for use in subsequent requests.

item.name: PHASE 5 - Unified Chat (WebSocket / STOMP)
item.description:
WebSocket real-time chat — STOMP over SockJS.

## Connection
Connect to: `ws://localhost:8080/api/v1/ws`
(SockJS HTTP fallback: `http://localhost:8080/api/v1/ws`)

## Authentication
Pass the JWT in the STOMP CONNECT frame:
```
CONNECT
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>
```

## Subscribe (receive messages)
```
SUBSCRIBE
destination:/topic/conversations/{conversationId}
```

## Send a message
```
SEND
destination:/app/conversations/{conversationId}/send
content-type:application/json

{"content":"Hello!","replyToId":null}
```

## Payload (MessageDto broadcast)
```json
{
  "id": 42,
  "content": "Hello!",
  "sender": { "id": 1, "username": "alice" },
  "conversationId": 7,
  "replyToId": null,
  "edited": false,
  "createdAt": "2026-06-21T10:30:00"
}
```

> Postman supports native WebSocket testing (Postman ≥ 9). Use the **WebSocket Request** tab, connect to the URL above, and manually send the STOMP frames shown here, or use a STOMP client library in your frontend.

request.description:
This is a placeholder to document the WebSocket connection.

To test WebSocket in Postman:
1. Click **New** → **WebSocket Request**
2. Enter URL: `ws://localhost:8080/api/v1/ws/websocket`
3. Connect, then send the STOMP CONNECT frame:
   ```
   CONNECT\nAuthorization:Bearer {{access_token}}\n\n\0
   ```
4. Subscribe to `/topic/conversations/{{conversation_id}}`
5. Send to `/app/conversations/{{conversation_id}}/send` with body `{"content":"Hi!"}`

Alternatively use a browser STOMP client (e.g. stompit, @stomp/stompjs).
